scope: Professional local-dashboard workflow and responsive-layout verification

environment.credential_values: synthetic placeholders used only to expose readiness states

checks.evidence: The selected synthetic AMR filename appeared in the single file-import control.
The local upload reached 100 percent and displayed source-hash retention status.
The UI displayed one second of recording coverage, one planned chunk, and the maximum approved cost before any provider run.
Fast Draft, SEA Multilingual, Speaker-labelled, and Compare & Verify were selectable; SEA Multilingual preferred the configured MERaLiON specialist route.
Advanced details disclosed the provider and model while the primary flow remained outcome-led.
No transcription started without the separate approval checkbox; this verification did not approve or start a provider run.
At 800 pixels, browser QA found and corrected grid stretching; the 1064-pixel import card and 161-pixel recent-jobs card retained independent intrinsic heights.
The complete Docker dry-run suite passed after the professional workflow implementation.

limitations: This verifies browser workflow, presentation, and control behaviour, not transcription accuracy.
Provider readiness used placeholder credentials and is not credential-validity evidence.
Authenticated hosting, background workers, multi-user roles, and external-user adoption remain unproven.
